desc.zh_HK: 卡式帶，標籤褪晒色，淨返一個「壽」字。
desc.zh_CN: 卡式磁带，标签褪了色，只剩一个「寿」字。
desc.en: A cassette; the label has faded until only one character is left.

use_locked.zh_HK: 呢卷卡式帶而家幫唔到手。
use_locked.zh_CN: 这卷卡带现在帮不上手。
use_locked.en: The cassette can't help right now.

text.zh_HK: 卡式帶一轉，機器聲蓋過一切。
text.zh_CN: 卡带一转，机器声盖过一切。
text.en: The cassette turns, and the sound of machines swallows everything.

_comment: The chapter-3 door: usable once ch02 is complete (the cassette is the family's voice, and it opens the mother's era). Chapter-5's door is the unsent letter, per PLAN §12.2.
